brief.summary_1line: Lakshmana and Indrajit engage in a ferocious arrow duel; taunts, shattered armor, and torrents of blood mark their evenly matched battle as Vibhishana moves to support Lakshmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana’s arrows shatter Indrajit’s golden armor, the pieces falling like a shower of stars from his chariot.
Lakshmana and Indrajit stand amid a storm of crossing arrows, their bodies bleeding and bristling with shafts like two blazing hills.
Vibhishana rushes into the battlefield to support the exhausted Lakshmana as the duel rages with thunderous bowstrings.
